newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH MUNIBOND TO START OTC TRADE MARCH 21.
newsitem.headline: POLISH MUNIBOND TO START OTC TRADE MARCH 21.

text.p: The 7.5-million-zloty bond issue of Polish town Ostrow Wielkopolski will start trade on Poland's regulated over-the-counter market on March 21, the OTC firm Centralna Tabela Ofert SA (CTO) said in a Friday statement.
The four-year bond issued last year would become the country's first publicly traded municipal bond.
The western Polish town has said it planned to launch another 7.5-million-zloty issue later this year which would also be traded on the OTC market and likely have a maturity exceeding four years.
Currently only machine tools maker Rafamet SA and insurer TUR Polisa trade on the country's fledgling OTC market.
